Zürich · MIT throughout · open to contributors

One trunk. Many products.

bitbaum builds AI-native products on infrastructure that is open by construction — 9 shared packages, one server, and a stack for moving value, dispatching work and deciding together. 14 products run today, all of them in beta. Take any of it, or come build here.

See the work → Build with us
14 in beta 9 open-source packages 44 repositories with proven origin 1 server

Three layers, so more than one person can build here

Working together needs more than a repository: a way to be paid, a way to get work done, and a way to decide. Each layer is a product in its own right, and each is what makes the next contributor possible.

OrangeCatEconomy
How value reaches people. Any identity — a person, a pseudonym, an AI agent — takes part in the economy without a bank's permission, and Bitcoin settles it.
LokiExecution
How work gets done. Dispatch it to a fleet of AI agents and people, watch it, approve it, ship it — agents execute where the code lives.
SolonGovernance
How decisions get made together. Bitcoin-signed votes and versioned policies, so nobody has to trust the count — including the rule that pays originators.

Build with us

Anyone can take this work or join it. Four doors, in order of how much they ask of you.

Use itMIT
Every package is MIT and installable today. Nothing to ask, nothing to sign. pnpm add @bitbaum/ai-kit
All packages →
Contributeopen PRs
Sign off your commits and open a pull request. A sweep merges anything green, so review is the only queue. git commit -s
Contributor termsRepositories
Be paid for it10%
A governed rule routes a tenth of a product's net revenue to the originators of the code it is built from — by default, split equally, on a public ledger.
The policyHow it is governed
Hire the studioZürich
Fractional CTO and contract engineering, with rates and scope published rather than quoted.
Rates and scopeWriting

Open by construction

Three things make "take it, or join it" safe to say out loud.

LicenceMIT, everywhere

Every product and package the studio owns is MIT. What is built for someone else stays theirs.

OriginProven nightly

Every repository's HEAD is stamped through OpenTimestamps and archived by Software Heritage, anchored in Bitcoin since block 966918. Git dates prove nothing; a block does. The register.

NumbersRead, not written

Stars, downloads, revenue and what has been paid back to originators are read nightly from sources that are not us, and published as they are. The readings.

bitbaum is built in Zürich, in the open. Nothing here is registered; an orangecat.ch name is an address on one server.
